purpose: Present an ordered set of related content in a bounded native-scroll rail with keyboard and indicator controls.
accessibility: Expose a labelled carousel region and slide positions.
Support Arrow keys, Home, End, visible focus, and reduced motion.
Keep native horizontal scrolling available when controls are not used.
responsive: Uses a bounded native scroll rail that keeps the next slide discoverable.
Caps slide width against the viewport without changing slide content.
motion: Uses shared smooth scrolling for explicit navigation.
Falls back to instant scrolling when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

api.name: children
api.description: Ordered slide content rendered inside the native scroll rail.

api.name: label
api.description: Accessible name for the carousel region.

api.name: slideWidth
api.description: Preferred slide width before the viewport cap is applied.

api.name: showIndicators
api.description: Whether position indicators are rendered below the rail.
